metadata.name: SEC_CIK_INDEX
metadata.comment:
Map between company identifiers (including Cybersyn's COMPANY_ID) and the SEC Central Index Keys (CIKs), along with geographic and industry classification details for SEC filers.

The SEC assigns a unique number, Central Index Key (CIK), to all entities (companies, individuals, and foreign governments) who file disclosures with the SEC. 
SIC, or Standard Industrial Classification, is a four-digit code provided by the SEC to classify the primary industry of a company. Originally developed by the U.S. government in the 1930s, SIC codes are used to categorize companies and facilitate the analysis of economic activities across government and private sectors.

COMPANY_ID.name: COMPANY_ID
COMPANY_ID.comment: Unique identifier assigned by Cybersyn to each company.

CIK.name: CIK
CIK.comment: Central Index Key (CIK). Ten digit number assigned by the SEC to each registrant that submits filings.

COMPANY_NAME.name: COMPANY_NAME
COMPANY_NAME.comment: Name of registrant. This corresponds to the name of the legal entity as of the latest filing date.

EIN.name: EIN
EIN.comment: Employee Identification Number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

SIC.name: SIC
SIC.comment: Standard Industrial Classification (SIC). Code assigned by the SEC indicating the registrant industry group.

SEC_FILER_CATEGORY.name: SEC_FILER_CATEGORY
SEC_FILER_CATEGORY.comment: Classification provided by the SEC as to the type of the registrant.

INCORPORATION_STATE.name: INCORPORATION_STATE
INCORPORATION_STATE.comment: Raw state code where the registrant was incorporated.

INCORPORATION_STATE_GEO_ID.name: INCORPORATION_STATE_GEO_ID
INCORPORATION_STATE_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the state where the registrant was incorporated. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

INCORPORATION_COUNTRY.name: INCORPORATION_COUNTRY
INCORPORATION_COUNTRY.comment: Raw country code where the registrant was incorporated.

INCORPORATION_COUNTRY_GEO_ID.name: INCORPORATION_COUNTRY_GEO_ID
INCORPORATION_COUNTRY_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the country where the registrant was incorporated. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

FISCAL_YEAR_END.name: FISCAL_YEAR_END
FISCAL_YEAR_END.comment: Fiscal year end recognized by the registrant.

ADDRESS_LINE_1.name: ADDRESS_LINE_1
ADDRESS_LINE_1.comment: Business address line 1 of the registrant.

ADDRESS_LINE_2.name: ADDRESS_LINE_2
ADDRESS_LINE_2.comment: Business address line 2 of the registrant.

CITY.name: CITY
CITY.comment: The city of the business address of the registrant.

STATE.name: STATE
STATE.comment: The state or province of the business address of the registrant.

STATE_GEO_ID.name: STATE_GEO_ID
STATE_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the state where the business is headquartered. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

ZIP.name: ZIP
ZIP.comment: Raw zip code of the business address of the registrant.

ZIP_GEO_ID.name: ZIP_GEO_ID
ZIP_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the zip where the business is headquartered. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

COUNTRY_GEO_ID.name: COUNTRY_GEO_ID
COUNTRY_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the country where the business is headquartered. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_1.name: MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_1
MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_1.comment: Mailing address line 1 of the registrant.

MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_2.name: MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_2
MAILING_ADDRESS_LINE_2.comment: Mailing address line 2 of the registrant.

MAILING_CITY.name: MAILING_CITY
MAILING_CITY.comment: The city of the mailing address of the registrant.

MAILING_STATE.name: MAILING_STATE
MAILING_STATE.comment: The state or province of the mailing address of the registrant.

MAILING_STATE_GEO_ID.name: MAILING_STATE_GEO_ID
MAILING_STATE_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the state of the mailing address. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

MAILING_ZIP.name: MAILING_ZIP
MAILING_ZIP.comment: Raw zip code of the mailing address of the registrant.

MAILING_ZIP_GEO_ID.name: MAILING_ZIP_GEO_ID
MAILING_ZIP_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the zip of the mailing address. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

MAILING_COUNTRY.name: MAILING_COUNTRY
MAILING_COUNTRY.comment: Raw country code of the mailing address of the registrant.

MAILING_COUNTRY_GEO_ID.name: MAILING_COUNTRY_GEO_ID
MAILING_COUNTRY_GEO_ID.comment: A unique identifier of the country of the mailing address. Joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table

metadata.name: SEC_REPORT_ATTRIBUTES
metadata.comment:
Company KPIs published in SEC filings using XBRL format, provided on a monthly basis.

Provides a wide format breakdown of variables included within an SEC report by ADSH and SIK.

This table provides the parsed XBRL line items from financial statements by a unique variable ID, which are associated with a particular report. This includes detailed metadata, tags, measure descriptions, unit of measurement, associated values, report IDs, statement types, and date details.

VARIABLE.name: VARIABLE
VARIABLE.comment: Unique identifier for each individual measure.

CIK.name: CIK
CIK.comment: Central Index Key (CIK). Ten digit number assigned by the SEC to each registrant that submits filings.

ADSH.name: ADSH
ADSH.comment: Accession Number assigned to each filing in the EDGAR system. Unique identifier for each individual filing. The Accession number can be used to track all records from a single filing.

MEASURE_DESCRIPTION.name: MEASURE_DESCRIPTION
MEASURE_DESCRIPTION.comment: The text presented on the line item in the original filing. Also known as a "preferred" label.

TAG.name: TAG
TAG.comment: Unique name of the variable or measurement that pertains to the value.

TAG_VERSION.name: TAG_VERSION
TAG_VERSION.comment: An identifier for the naming convention version of a given tag.

UNIT_OF_MEASURE.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
UNIT_OF_MEASURE.comment: The unit of measure for the value.

VALUE.name: VALUE
VALUE.comment: The value. This is not scaled, it is as found in the Interactive Data file, but is rounded to four digits to the right of the decimal point.

REPORT.name: REPORT
REPORT.comment: Represents the report grouping. This is the sequential order of the line item in the XBRL data.

STATEMENT.name: STATEMENT
STATEMENT.comment: The financial statement location to which the value of the "report" field pertains.

PERIOD_START_DATE.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
PERIOD_START_DATE.comment: Period start date of the value. For point-in-time values such as balance sheet items, this is the same as the period_end_date.

PERIOD_END_DATE.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
PERIOD_END_DATE.comment: Period end date of the value.

COVERED_QTRS.name: COVERED_QTRS
COVERED_QTRS.comment: The count of the number of quarters represented by the data value, rounded to the nearest whole number. "0" indicates it is a point-in-time value (e.g., cash balance as of a particular date).

METADATA.name: METADATA
METADATA.comment: Concatenation of tag names representing the axis and members appearing in the XBRL segments. Tag names have their first characters "Statement", last 4 characters "Axis", and last 6 characters "Member" or "Domain" truncated where they appear. Namespaces and prefixes are ignored because EDGAR validation guarantees that the local-names are unique with a submission. Each dimension is represented as the pair "{axis}={member};" and the axes concatenated in lexical order. Example: "LegalEntity=Xyz;Scenario=Restated;" represents the XBRL segment with dimension LegalEntityAxis and member XyzMember, dimension StatementScenarioAxis and member RestatedMember.
